page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 128 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, providing 128 dedicated vCPUs. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per core. This dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute performance without virtualization overhead, operating under a KVM hypervisor.

This instance integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

The hardware profile represents a high-density resource allocation, particularly for GPU-accelerated and compute-intensive tasks. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs depending on the workload.

This server configuration is designed for workloads requiring parallel GPU processing and high CPU core counts, such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, 3D rendering, and large-scale simulation tasks.
